node_definition.done_when: scripts/vacuum_loop_adjudication.py reaches JT-60SA by a machine selection, or by a per-channel vacuum fit extracted from it that both machines call, with no second adjudication script; for E100595, E100579 and E100642 it builds the OP1 description's operator with build_operator, predicts every bound loop and probe from the measured MMSYS coil currents through ForwardOperator.vacuum_prediction, reads each measured channel raw from the EDDB cache with imas_ambix/data/eddb.py read_channel, and writes docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-vacuum-adjudication.html and docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-vacuum-adjudication.json tabling per channel and shot the fitted slope, offset and Pearson r and a verdict: identity or negate when the absolute slope is within 0.1 of 1 at r above 0.98 on every shot, otherwise undecided with its reason; MAST's default run reproduces its existing verdicts; the run is captured to a log on the fleet compute node; ruff check on the changed paths exits 0
node_definition.goal: Adjudicate JT-60SA's 27 flux loops and 17 tangential probes against vacuum predictions on the three OP1 vacuum shots
node_definition.negative_control: swapping the measured channels of two probes leaves both verdicts unchanged
